rationale: The candidate directly identifies `cmd.Flags()` and accurately states that it returns the complete `*flag.FlagSet`. This is supported by `command.go:1641-1653`, whose comment says `Flags` returns the complete set applying to the command, including local and persistent flags declared there and by all parents. The additional subset methods are also supported: `LocalFlags()` appears at `command.go:1669-1672`, and `InheritedFlags()` is explicitly described at `command.go:1695-1698` as returning flags inherited from parent commands.
